QUOTE: a value stated at call time, such as a CLI flag or an option passed through the MCP `build_or_refresh` / `build_index` calls. `buildoptions.py` documents this as the top tier, and it is the only tier an MCP caller can reach.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says tier 1 is reachable via both a CLI flag and options passed through MCP calls, and that it is the only tier an MCP caller can reach, so a caller with no shell can still state the top tier.
